title: Models used in the avalanche warning system and their sources
note: Prepared 11 Nov 2026, Tech Early Warning Wing, NGT, NDMA

models.Details: Models: ACCESS-CM2, EC-Earth3, GFDL-ESM4, MIROC6, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MRI-ESM2-0. Scenarios SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5; historical 1985-2014.

models.Purpose: Predicts weather over the next 10-15 days
models.Repository / source: ECMWF IFS (0.25°, open data, CC-BY 4.0) via Open-Meteo
models.Details: Main forecast plus 51-member ensemble. Free for non-commercial use; operational use needs an Open-Meteo API key.

models.Repository / source: Built in-house (NDMA NGT); thresholds from ERA5 reanalysis 1970-2026 and recorded avalanches
models.Details: Code: step3_local_rules.py, step8_projection_rule.py. Thresholds: rules\tile_thresholds.csv, projection\projection_rule.json.
